none: PAS SUR-0387B6: Roman: Horse and rider plate brooch
contea di ritrovamento: Hampshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A Roman copper-alloy enamelled plate brooch depicting a horse and rider going right. The brooch has seven cells for enamel, which is now all missing. Part of the horse's front leg is also missing and the back leg is bent forward. The hair of the rider and the mane of the horse are both clearly accentuated with inscribed lines. On the reverse the spring survives and there are traces of an iron…
